subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` default to reattach, wait, and replay an accepted disconnected Gateway run before using the existing automatic isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the user-visible ambiguity policy described by the open canonical issue; code review cannot determine the preferred latency, streaming, and authoritative-result tradeoff.

options.title: Approve layered recovery
options.body: Adopt reattach/wait/cache-only replay first and retain the existing isolated automatic fallback only when recovery cannot establish an outcome.

options.title: Keep recook-first
options.body: Retain current main's immediate isolated embedded fallback after an uncertain accepted disconnect and close or narrow this PR accordingly.

recommendation.title: Approve layered recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt reattach/wait/cache-only replay first and retain the existing isolated automatic fallback only when recovery cannot establish an outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current main fallback boundary that defines the compatibility tradeoff.
